name: Kouyama Shiori
source:
The wife of the protagonist Junjiro.

In the past she was pessimistic about life due to her family, but met Junjiro and his best friend Yousuke when she was a student, became friends with them and began to regain hope in the world.

[Translated from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=1082225]Getchu[/url]]
